<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The '''Tree of Might''' is a giant tree that grows in a swamp on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], with a canopy about 340 blocks wide. The clearing under it is the lair of the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|world boss]] [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]].
</translate>

<translate>
== The tree == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
* The tree's wood and roots are '''unbreakable'''.
* Its rare glowing fruit drops the '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Fruit of the Tree of Might|Fruit of the Tree of Might]]'''.
* In worlds created before the tree was added, it still appears: because it's too big to place at once, it's filled in gradually and visibly grows (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Existing worlds|Existing worlds]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Turles == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
{{Main|Turles}}
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] sleeps in the clearing under the tree. His lair is only set up once the Tree of Might has been generated, and he wakes when a survival or adventure player comes within 32 blocks. See [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]] for how lairs, waking and respawning work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
The Tree of Might generates once per world, in a swamp at least 1,000 blocks from the world origin. Operators can see where Turles' lair is with {{Command|/dmzworldboss locate}}, and players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate tree_of_might}}.
</translate>
